law: Distributed actors share many characteristics with Swift actors, and include additional isolation checks to ensure location transparency and safety in a distributed environment.
You use three main parts when writing code with distributed actors: Swift language support for actors and distributed actors.
The Distributed module, which includes the types and protocols you need to declare and use distribute actors.
A distributed actor is always part of some distributed actor system; that distributed actor system handles the serialization and networking necessary to perform remote method calls.
For local testing, you can use .
For production, you can use the distributed actor system from the library, use another library, or write your own distributed actor system.
